propositions: max_consecutive_repeat metric is blind to cycles of length >= 2 because it only detects adjacent identical signatures, scoring a genuine 4-call cycle as 1 while healthy breadth scores 5

a windowed distinct-ratio computed over trailing 24 tool-call signatures provides order-insensitive cycle detection that fires at ratio <= 0.50 on pathological runs but stays above 0.833 on healthy sequences

the new distinct_ratio_window field must be added to _repetition_summary output as a module-level constant alongside REPETITION_WINDOW=24 and REPETITION_TRIP_RATIO=0.50, computed as set cardinality divided by window size rounded to 3 decimals
the distinct_ratio_window field must return None when fewer than REPETITION_WINDOW signatures exist to prevent false positives on short sequences
existing max_consecutive_repeat and other counters must retain unchanged meaning and field names; the new signal is purely additive and does not alter the sidecar contract
